in_marathi.name: Neeranjana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Flowing river goddess
in_marathi.long_meaning: Neeranjana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Neera (flowing water) + Anjana (goddess of fertility and nourishment). This name is derived from the Hindu mythology where the goddess Anjana is the divine mother of Hanuman.
